title: How to View Invoice History in Swash Laundry Software (SLS) | Step-by-Step Tutorial
description:
How to View Invoice History in Swash Laundry Software (SLS)

Welcome to the official Swash Laundry Software (SLS) tutorial series.

In this video, you'll learn how to view and manage Invoice History in Swash Laundry Software. This feature helps you track all invoices, review order details, monitor payment status, and quickly find past transactions.

In this video, you'll learn:
How to open the Invoice History module
How to search invoices
How to filter invoices by date
How to search by customer or invoice number
How to view invoice details
How to check payment status
How to print or export invoices

Swash Laundry Software (SLS) is a complete laundry management solution that helps you manage customers, orders, invoicing, billing, payments, pickup & delivery, reports, inventory, rack management, bag management, and much more.
